# SEED — The Language of Spirit Dialogues (2010)

## Chicago 18 forms

**Full note:** SEED Graduate Institute, *The 12th Annual International Language of Spirit Conference* (2010), {page}, https://indigenize.wordpress.com/wp-content/uploads/2009/11/seed-dialogues-2010-los-2010.pdf.

**Shortened note:** SEED Graduate Institute, *Language of Spirit*, {page}.

**Bibliography:** SEED Graduate Institute. *The 12th Annual International Language of Spirit Conference*. 2010. https://indigenize.wordpress.com/wp-content/uploads/2009/11/seed-dialogues-2010-los-2010.pdf.

## Essay use

Institutional source for the history and form of the Language of Spirit dialogues: Leroy Little Bear and F. David Peat's 1992 approach to Bohm, SEED's later foundation, and the combination of Indigenous talking-circle and Bohmian dialogue practices.

**Claim boundary:** the institutional brochure warrants the programme's stated aims and documented existence. Claims about Indigenous participants' knowledge require participant-authored sources that preserve local sovereignty, names, and contexts; a generic “Indigenous worldview” is inadmissible.

### q003 · PDF 6

Pat McCabe's participant-authored abstract names culturally different tools of perception and a relational concern. It supplies a named voice, not a universal Indigenous doctrine.
